reason: This plugin is primarily a desktop-wrapper utility for users of the DSH web GUI, as shown by its name, description, and README, which describe an Electron-based native windowed client that embeds the web interface while hiding browser UI and backend command details. It additionally includes local process lifecycle features (single-instance windows, tray behavior, hidden bootstrap/startup of the dsh web backend, and multiple launch entry points), matching a user-facing desktop application purpose.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于将 DSH Web 界面封装为本地桌面 Electron 应用并运行，支持从侧边栏、桌面快捷方式或命令行打开，同时在需要时本地启动并托管对应的 dsh web 服务。
summaries.en: This plugin wraps the DSH web interface in a local Electron desktop app, letting users launch it from the DSH UI, a desktop shortcut, or the command line while managing the local dsh web service as needed.

capabilities: launches a native desktop Electron shell for the DSH web interface
auto-starts the local dsh web service when needed and reuses a local loopback connection
manages app lifecycle behavior including single-instance window handling and tray minimization
exposes launch pathways via side panel UI, CLI entrypoint, and shortcut helpers
